name: Invoice by Ouroboros Apps
description: Invoice by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com). Freelance invoice records: approved invoice line items, quantities, agreed rates, due dates, and late terms; invoice changes need explicit approval. Tools: list_invoices, begin_invoice, read_invoice, place_line, describe_line, quote_line_rate, set_line_quantity, set_invoice_due, write_late_terms, offer_discount, seal_invoice, suggest_invoice_change, accept_invoice_change. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/invoice. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/invoice.
author: Ouroboros Apps
